headline: Meta Q3 Profit Surges as AI App Muse Surpasses 10 Million Users
summary: Meta Platforms reported a sharp jump in third-quarter net income to $9.86 billion, with revenue beating estimates and its AI app Muse reaching over 10 million users.
why: Meta is one of the world's largest digital advertising platforms, and investors closely monitor its return on artificial intelligence investments.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Net income more than tripling and revenue beating estimates signal strong monetization and user growth.

why_moved: Meta shares traded firmer after the company reported quarterly net income of $9.86 billion, beating Wall Street revenue expectations and highlighting AI app growth.
